episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa is trapped in an MMORPG called The World. With his conscious inaccessible, Tsukasa attempts to find his purpose for being in the game.
episodes.title: Role Play

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa’s inability to log out of the world worries Mimiru. The Crimson Knights, on the other hand, see Tsukasa as a threat.
episodes.title: Guardian

episodes.synopsis: BT and Sora suspect that Tsukasa is somehow connected to a very important artifact, the Key of the Twilight.
episodes.title: Folklore

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa's rampaging Guardian monster wreaks havoc in The World, and an edict from Subaru makes him a wanted man.
episodes.title: Wanted

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa finally tames his Guardian monster, but unbeknownst to him, someone is plotting his capture.
episodes.title: Captured

episodes.synopsis: Subaru carefully observes Tsukasa, gradually getting to know him. Sora mounts a rescue mission.
episodes.title: Encounter

episodes.synopsis: Mimiru encounters a novice player and offers her guidance in The World. This new relationship helps Mimiru uncover her own motivation for playing.
episodes.title: Reason

episodes.synopsis: Mimiru extends Tsukasa an invitation to meet; BT and Crim share an interesting encounter.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: An elite hacker proves instrumental in the quest for the Key of the Twilight, and Tsukasa gets stuck with a sick Grunty.
episodes.title: Epitaph

episodes.synopsis: Bear's shortcomings as a father may be the root of his concern for Tsukasa. Clues arise as the search for the Key of the Twilight continues.
episodes.title: Compensation

episodes.synopsis: Mimiru, Bear, and Tsukasa join forces before embarking on a non-fighting quest.
episodes.title: Party

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa stumbles upon Aura, an advanced AI, that is being held captive.
episodes.title: Entanglement

episodes.synopsis: A way to open the Twilight Eye is discovered, and the group decides to follow the new path unfolding before them.
episodes.title: Twilight Eye

episodes.synopsis: After the Eye is opened, a secret area appears, complicating the group's search for the key.
episodes.title: Castle

episodes.synopsis: Revisit all the major moments from this groundbreaking anime in a series of vivid flashbacks that may shed new light on past events!
episodes.title: Evidence

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa logs back into The World, only to discover that he cannot die. Shocked, he turns to Subaru for answers.
episodes.title: Depth

episodes.synopsis: Crim refuses to meet BT outside of the game. Later, Tsukasa mounts a rescue attempt – and secrets are revealed.
episodes.title: Conflict

episodes.synopsis: Silver Knight disrupts any and all potential rendezvous between Subaru and Tsukasa. Subaru ponders the future of the Crimson Knights.
episodes.title: Declaration

episodes.synopsis: Subaru drifts aimlessly through The World, reflecting on her past experiences. Her connection with Tsukasa grows even stronger after an unexpected attack.
episodes.title: Recollection

episodes.synopsis: Aura goes missing, Morganna attacks Tsukasa, and the search for the Key of the Twilight continues.
episodes.title: Tempest

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa lingers in a catatonic state, and some immensely powerful monsters make their presence felt in The World.
episodes.title: Despair

episodes.synopsis: Bear, Mimiru, and Subaru are attacked by yet another seemingly-unstoppable monster, but Balmung comes to the rescue.
episodes.title: Phantom

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa is too frightened to pass through Helba's gate, and Crim explains Subaru's true life condition.
episodes.title: The Eve

episodes.synopsis: Upon arriving in Helba's realm – Net Slum – the group is forced to defend Subaru from an attack by Morganna.
episodes.title: Net Slum

episodes.synopsis: As the battle intensifies, the group seeks shelter in the Cathedral. Morganna summons Guardians to do her bidding.
episodes.title: Catastrophe

episodes.synopsis: Drawing strength from Subaru, Tsukasa summons the courage to awaken Aura. Outside of The World, players share a true life encounter.
episodes.title: Return
